## Upstream changes 6.66.0 -> 6.67.0

**Verdict:** SAFE TO APPLY — the notes contain only additive features, enhancements and bug fixes; no breaking changes, no renamed/removed variables, and this is a Terraform provider (not a long-running container), so the "companion service version" and image-comparison concerns don't apply here. The version pin `~> 6.66.0` in `01-providers.tf` will need to be widened to pick up 6.67.0.

### Breaking changes
- none found in the notes

### Variables
- none renamed or removed. One new optional behavior-toggle variable was added: `resource/aws_route53_record: Add the TF_AWS_ROUTE53_RECORD_BATCH_READS environment variable to reduce AWS API calls when managing many records in a zone` ([#48525](https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-aws/issues/48525)). This is an opt-in environment variable read by the provider at runtime (not a Terraform variable, not referenced in `.env.example`); no action required unless you want to use it. The 6.67.0 NOTES section flags this feature as experimental: "Batched reads is experimental. The behavior may change without notice, and it is not subject to the backwards compatibility guarantee of the provider."

### Data and dependencies
- none. No companion service (database, cache, search engine) version requirements appear in these notes, and the compose/provider file here pins only the `hashicorp/aws` Terraform provider plus `tls`, `random`, and `helm` providers, none of which are touched by this release.

### Before applying
- Edit `01-providers.tf`: the `required_providers.aws.version` constraint is currently `~> 6.66.0`, which will not permit 6.67.0. Widen it (e.g. to `~> 6.67.0` or `>= 6.66.0, < 7.0.0`) to allow the upgrade.
- Run `terraform init -upgrade` to pull the new provider version, then `terraform plan` to confirm no unexpected diffs before applying — this is routine practice for a provider bump, not something the notes specifically require.
- No state migration, no manual data steps.

### Notes read
- hashicorp/terraform-provider-aws release notes and CHANGELOG.md for `6.67.0` (covering the full range from `6.66.0` to `6.67.0`, the only entry between the two versions).

## Upstream changes 2026.9.2 -> 2026.10.0

**Verdict:** SAFE TO APPLY — only dependency bumps and a bundled-tool addition; no breaking changes, no variable or port/volume changes.

### Breaking changes
- none found in the notes

### Variables
- none

### Data and dependencies
- The registry diff shows the bundled JDK moved from `jdk-25.0.4+7` to `jdk-25.0.4.1+1` — a patch-level JDK bump, not called out in the release notes themselves but confirmed as a real image difference.
- Release notes list routine dependency bumps: `itzg/mc-monitor` to v0.18.0, then v0.18.1, then v1; `itzg/mc-image-helper` to v1.70.0, v1.70.1, v1.70.2; a Docker base image bump via dependabot ("bump the docker group with 3 updates"); and addition of `jattach` ("Add jattach" by @nelsongraca). None of these are described as breaking.
- No companion-service version (database, cache, search engine) is named in the notes, so the compose file's lack of such a pin is not a mismatch here.

### Before applying
- No manual migration or config edit required.
- Standard precaution: confirm the proxy still starts and both ports (25565 TCP, 19132/udp) come up correctly after pulling, since a JDK point revision and a Docker base image bump landed even though the notes don't describe behavioral change.

### Notes read
- 2026.10.0 release notes (covering the 2026.9.2...2026.10.0 range), as quoted above. No UPGRADING, BREAKING_CHANGES, or CHANGELOG section was supplied, so none was consulted beyond the release notes text given.
